objects.description: [Shai-Hulud](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9008) has attempted to gain root access by leveraging `sudo` and `/etc/sudoers.d`.(Citation: Socket Shai-Hulud November 2025)
objects.description_fa: [Shai-Hulud](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9008) تلاش کرده است با استفاده از «sudo» و «/etc/sudoers.d» به دسترسی ریشه دست یابد.(Citation: Socket Shai-Hulud November 2025)
